extra_quotes: Using the pulsed laser deposition (PLD) approach in oxygen atmospheres with the KrF excimer laser (248 nm), GFO thin films are deposited on fluorine-doped tin oxide-coated glass (FTO) substrates at 600 ºC.
Field emission scanning electron microscope (FESEM) and energy-dispersive X-ray (EDAX) spectra are studied using FEI QUANTA FEG-250 with the attachment of AMETEK EDAX QUANTA 200.
X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) measurements are performed using a ULV AC-PHI 5000 Versa Probe III system under ultra -high vacuum conditions (5 × 10−10 mbar).
Frequency-dependent dielectric measurements are performed using an LCR meter (NF Corporation ZM2376) for a frequency range of 1 kHz–1 MHz at room temperature.

The AFM and PFM measurements are performed on a commercial MFP-3D 5 Asylum Research and Oxford Instruments Company AFM system (Asylum Research, Santa Barbara, CA, USA) using Dual AC Resonance Tracking (DART) PFM mode.
Their high apparent permittivity and relatively low conductivity are promising for practical applications, although further optimization is needed to reduce dielectric loss and energy dissipation.
